architecture_findings: The independent Source Discovery → Source Assessment DAG is active: both adapters are enabled and restricted to the Watchdog caller. Watchdog resolves the exact producer run, head SHA and immutable artifact digest, then deduplicates Assessment by exact predecessor run ID. The latest reconciliation verified Discovery run 42373818238 and its artifact; it found two historical Assessment tasks (one duplicate) and correctly suppressed a third enqueue because a verified Assessment already exists. A fresh one-to-one post-merge Assessment execution is still required.
Both source capabilities write only to isolated RUNNER_TEMP artifact roots; the main-branch source documents are read-only baselines.
Assessment's only shared mutation is the per-URL task checkpoint in GitHub Issue #423, guarded by task lease and logical resource fences.

The production publisher is the single controlled writer for the three policy outputs rulesets/direct.list, rulesets/proxy.list and rulesets/reject.list, together with their required manifest/lifecycle/queue metadata. This is a production-output boundary, not a system-wide automation write restriction. Watchdog queue/checkpoint state, immutable Actions artifacts and runner-local workspaces are inventoried separately; modules/uu.conf and user-managed module/JavaScript assets remain unwritable.
Other non-dispatchable Python capabilities retain default-deny status until their own complete transitive side-effect and resource contracts are reviewed.

Daily Discovery idempotency now fingerprints the producer, Watchdog handoff, durable queue, scheduler, fencing, Assessment, verifier and their active contracts; changes in the DAG receive a new same-day task key without weakening per-revision deduplication.

Watchdog queue reads and task supervision are serialized per main branch to reduce GitHub Issues API rate-limit pressure; the append-only queue remains authoritative and the 15-minute schedule recovers coalesced workflow_run callbacks. Discovery and Assessment are also serialized by the shared logical/source-dag-supervision lease acquired atomically with task claim and held through verification.
decomposition_constraints: Preserve the audit -> publish dependency and the existing single-writer concurrency boundary.
A capability can run alone only after its input snapshot, output artifacts, dependencies, resource leases, timeout/retry, idempotency and independent verifier are implemented.
The publish job must not be decomposed into independently writable capability jobs without a single controlled publisher.
The review cursor recovery job runs only after audit failure and must remain a recovery path.
Dashboard generation is observer-only and is not a production stage.

review_context.note: The independent source DAG is enabled under the scoped release allowlist. The production deliverables are exactly DIRECT, PROXY and REJECT; queue/checkpoint state and immutable runner-local artifacts are separate control-plane/runtime resources. The global static/transitive inventory remains partial for unrelated capabilities.
review_context.source_dag_scope: End-to-end Watchdog-owned Discovery → immutable artifact verification → non-activating Assessment → immutable Assessment artifact proof → production artifact re-verification → source matrix → deterministic admission → production collection. REJECT is automatically published after deterministic first-stage review, stricter secondary evidence gates and config-conflict checks; human review is exception-only; uu.conf is read-only.

duplicate_protection.rule: The Watchdog classifies existing Assessment tasks by exact predecessor.workflow_run_id, with legacy idempotency-key compatibility. A verified successful Assessment suppresses re-enqueue; a queued/claimed/verifying or retry-required Assessment suppresses replacement Discovery. Only a predecessor with no matching Assessment may enqueue once under the canonical source-assessment:<workflow_run_id> key. When SOURCE_DISCOVERY_MODE=independent, auto_sync monolithic discovery/assessment remain disabled.

activation.repository_write_authority: rulesets/** repository publication path fence; control-plane and runner-local resources are inventoried separately

repository_write_policy: Per-capability explicit exclusive resource_contract.resource_keys; control-plane state is separately inventoried. The production publisher stages only the three ruleset deliverables under rulesets/**; this is not a global automation write restriction.
